source.label: Ola’s verified delivery tallies — 17–18 September 2026
source.description: Authoritative tally counts supplied by Ola. Thursday: 7 6F5 + 4 Type 1/recycled Type 1 = 11. Friday: 17 6F5 + 4 Type 1 = 21. Counts are delivery visits, not tonnes. Arrival times were not reliably recorded for these aggregate rows and are shown as an em dash. Handwritten arrival notes are incomplete and never recalculate or override the tallies.

metricDefinitions.label: Delivery visits
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of the four authoritative date/material tally rows: 11 + 21 = 32. Material totals: 24 6F5 + 8 Type 1/recycled Type 1. Friday Type 1 is included in the combined Type 1 category for charts; its original label is preserved in the table.

methods.code: Filter by exact date, then sum deliveries from the supplied tallies. Never infer individual arrivals or weights. Missing times stay —. Group Type 1 and Type 1 / recycled Type 1 together only for aggregate material summaries.

source.label: Ola’s site context and verified day register
source.description: Both dates have recorded delivery tallies. Thursday site opening hours were previously supplied by Ola; Friday site hours were not supplied. Site hours are operating context, not individual arrival times.

methods.code: Preserve supplied site operating hours separately from delivery tallies. Do not infer Friday hours or individual delivery times.
